scope: Narrow read-only Equipment/Apply audit; new documentation/harness files only

findings.classification: confirmed production Lua completion defect under public inventory mocks
findings.trigger: Requested included gear is missing; either every mismatch is missing or another requested item is available
findings.actual: Warns, emits APPLY_DONE(true,DONE), clears checkpoint; actual AnyGearChangeNeeded remains true and IsProfileFullyApplied false
findings.proposal: Carry missing identities through completion and report incomplete gear truthfully while preserving available-item swaps and recovery checkpoint

findings.classification: confirmed production Lua cancellation ownership defect under native-operation mocks
findings.trigger: Cancel while gear is queued for regen or while an active swap waits for its next deferred continuation
findings.actual: APPLY_DONE(false,CANCELLED) is emitted, then pending/active gear work still equips after cancellation; stale callback guard prevents a second APPLY_DONE but not the mutation
findings.proposal: Owner-scoped Equipment cancellation with generation-guarded pending/active continuations; invoke from cancellation/abort without rolling back committed gear or clearing foreign cursor state
findings.acceptance: REPORT.md; bank-withdraw ownership still requires coverage
